tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Use this when you need the valid values for the other tools: services (key and name), cities with clinics, species and the currency. Not for free times, clinics or prices themselves.

tools.name: search_vet_slots
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a free vet appointment (eläinlääkäriaika, veterinærtime) in Finland or Norway: one service (vaccination/rokotus, health check, neutering/kastraatio, dental, ...) in one city, optionally for one species and date. Returns the free times (date, time, clinic, price, bookingU

tools.name: list_clinics
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which vet clinics (eläinlääkäriasemat, dyreklinikker) there are in a city in Finland or Norway: name, chain, address, their services, their price for a service and a link to the clinic's page on the site. Not for emergencies or booking; get_clinic gives one clinic's detai

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one vet clinic in Finland or Norway by name: its address, phone, whether it is a 24 h emergency clinic, its services with prices and free times, and its page on the site. Not for finding clinics (list_clinics) or free times (search_vet_slots).

tools.name: search_vets
tools.description: Use this when the user describes the need in their own words rather than naming one service: a symptom or reason ("koira ontuu", "kissa oksentaa", "hampaat", "limping"), a treatment name, or a clinic's or vet's name, in Finnish, Swedish, English or Norwegian. tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a vet service costs in Finland or Norway (paljonko maksaa, hva koster): the price range of a service and each clinic's price, cheapest first, optionally in one city.
